entries.name: DEPUTY_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: A Deputy permanent token made for KaratOS. It acts as the person who made it, with their access level, and Deputy has no read-only token, so the connector itself sends only reads. It goes only to the business's Deputy install.
howToGet: Signed in to Deputy as a Location Manager or System Administrator who can see costs, open https://<install>/exec/devapp/oauth_clients, add a Client ID named KaratOS, and choose Get an Access Token.
Deputy shows the token once. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: DEPUTY_INSTALL
entries.description: The business's Deputy install, as its host: the part of the address before /, like example.na.deputy.com.
howToGet: Copy it from the browser's address bar while signed in to Deputy.
